name: Maguindanao (Philippines, 1973–2022)
description: A plain green field with the official seal of the Province of Maguindanao in the centre.
history: Maguindanao was divided into Maguindanao del Norte and Maguindanao del Sur in 2022, and the ISO 3166-2 code PH-MAG was withdrawn in favour of PH-MGN and PH-MGS. The seal is dated 1973.

features.role: official seal of the Province of Maguindanao
